title: jjunction global config
description: ~/.config/jjunction/config.toml — per-machine settings. Hand-maintained (two keys, scattered call sites): update together with src/config/trust.rs (trusted-repos) and resolve_machine (machine).

machine.description: Machine identity overriding the hostname for `machines = [...]` selectors. Normalized on use: trimmed, trailing dot dropped, lowercased; FQDNs must be listed in full.

trusted-repos.description: Workspace roots allowed to apply [[repo]] and [[link]] entries (direnv-allow style; appended by `jjn trust`).
